|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴ部隊を効果的に展開することにより、広範囲な地域を素早く制圧することができる。帝国が惑星を占領する際に用いる、きわめて有効な戦術だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Walker Garrison.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. (1) Play if Veers is at an outdoor Hoth location. Spend 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one AT-AT and put it into your hand. Shuffle, cut and replace the deck. (2) Play if your AT-ATs occupy three or more different Hoth locations. Each of your Force drains at Hoth locations is +2 this turn.

'''Lore:'''
Deploying AT-AT units effectively makes it possible to seize control of a wide area quickly. The Empire uses this highly effective tactic when occupying a planet.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location) for those conditions and explicitly says three or more.
